s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive orbital swelling with vision deterioration and proptosis
salient_findings: Left fronto-orbital swelling of 10 years’ duration
Progressive deterioration of vision in the left eye
Proptosis with inferior and medial displacement of the left globe
Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof on MRI
key_facts: 35-year-old woman
Left fronto-orbital swelling for 10 years
Progressive vision deterioration in the left eye over 1.5 years
Proptosis became more pronounced over the past month
Left globe displaced inferiorly and medially
No history of endocrine abnormalities
Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof on MRI
Expansive lytic bony lesion involving the superior and lateral walls of the orbit on CT
Lesion involves the orbital roof, frontal bone, and sphenoid wing

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof and involvement of the sphenoid wing are consistent with meningioma

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Expansive lytic bony lesion involving the orbital roof, frontal bone, and sphenoid wing is suggestive of fibrous dysplasia

shortlist.label: Sphenoid wing meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Involvement of the sphenoid wing and heterogeneous enhancing mass are consistent with sphenoid wing meningioma

shortlist.label: Orbital lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive orbital swelling and vision deterioration could be due to orbital lymphoma

shortlist.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Long-standing orbital swelling and proptosis are consistent with plexiform neurofibroma

raw.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous enhancing mass in the left orbital roof and an expansive lytic bony lesion involving the superior and lateral walls of the orbit, including the orbital roof, frontal bone, and sphenoid wing, is most consistent with a sphenoid wing meningioma, which typically arises from the dura mater of the sphenoid wing and can cause proptosis and vision deterioration by displacing the globe.

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Too general, as the specific location of the meningioma is crucial for diagnosis

rejected.label: Fibrous dysplasia
rejected.why: Typically presents with ground-glass appearance on imaging and may not cause significant mass effect or vision deterioration

rejected.label: Orbital lymphoma
rejected.why: Usually presents with a more rapid onset of symptoms and may not cause bony destruction

rejected.label: Plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: Typically associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 and presents with multiple neurofibromas, not a single orbital mass
